name: Reeve Halda
text: The reeve keeps the peace in Westhold, and pays those who help her keep it.

name: Factor Imre
text: A trader with business all along the border, and never enough couriers.

name: Warden Osk
text: The old hill warden watches the passes for trouble.

name: Sister Berit
text: The temple's almoner. She can call the dead back, if the party does the temple a service first.

name: Brother Aldo
text: A road-priest who keeps the shrine by the east gate, and keeps a list of favours owed.

name: Father Wend
text: The hill priest. He asks a hard service for a life, but he asks no coin.
